name: ultimatter
description: Universal Mobile Gateway & Reverse Proxy SDK for Local Dev & AI Coding Agents

scripts.build:win: npx @yao-pkg/pkg bin/cli.js --output bin/ultimatter-windows-x64.exe --targets node22-win-x64 && node scripts/inject-windows-icon.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:appimage && npm run build:linux && npm run build:mac && npm run build:macos:app && npm run build:win
scripts.pack:release: mv bin/ultimatter-linux-x64 bin/ultimatter && tar -czf bin/ultimatter-linux-x64.tar.gz -C bin ultimatter && mv bin/ultimatter bin/ultimatter-linux-x64
